verses.text: “Look at my servant, the one I hold up. I chose him, and my whole heart delights in him. I've put my Spirit on him, and he'll bring justice to the nations.
He won't shout or raise his voice to make himself heard in the street.
He won't snap a bruised reed or put out a wick that's barely burning. He'll faithfully bring justice.
He won't give out or lose heart before he's established justice on earth. The islands wait for his teaching.”

Here's what God the LORD says, the one who made the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and everything that grows from it, who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk it.
“I, the LORD, called you in righteousness. I'll hold your hand and keep you safe. I'll make you a covenant for the people and a light for the nations,
to open blind eyes, bring prisoners out of the dungeon, and get people sitting in darkness out of prison.
“I am the LORD. That's my name. I won't give my glory to anyone else or give my praise to carved idols.
Look, what I said before has happened. Now I'm announcing new things. I'll tell you about them before they even come up.”
Sing the LORD a new song! Let his praise ring from the ends of the earth, from you who go down to the sea and everything in it, from the islands and everyone who lives there.
Let the wilderness and its towns raise their voices, along with the villages where Kedar lives. People of Sela, sing! Shout from the mountaintops!
Give the LORD glory and tell the islands what he's worthy of.
The LORD will go out like a mighty warrior and stir up his zeal like someone going to battle. He'll raise a battle cry and shout out loud. He'll defeat his enemies.
“I've been quiet a long time. I kept still and held myself back. Now I'll cry out like someone in labor. I'll gasp and pant.
I'll lay mountains and hills to waste and dry up everything growing on them. I'll turn rivers into islands and dry up the pools.

I'll bring blind people along a road they don't know and lead them on paths they've never taken. I'll turn the darkness ahead of them into light and straighten out the crooked places. I'll do all of that and won't leave them behind.
“People who trust carved images and tell cast idols, ‘You're our gods,’ will be turned back and completely put to shame.
“If you're deaf, listen! If you're blind, look so you can see!
Who's blind like my own servant? Who's as deaf as the messenger I send? Who's as blind as the one at peace with me, as blind as the LORD's servant?
You see plenty and still don't pay attention. His ears are open and he still doesn't listen.
The LORD took pleasure, for the sake of his righteousness, in making his teaching great and honorable.

But these people have been robbed and picked clean. They're all trapped in holes, hidden away in prisons. They've been taken captive, and nobody rescues them. They've become plunder, and nobody says, ‘Give them back!’
Which of you will listen to this? Who'll pay attention now and keep listening for the days ahead?
Who handed Jacob over as plunder and Israel over to robbers? Wasn't it the LORD, the one we sinned against? They refused to walk his paths and disobeyed his teaching.
So he poured out his fierce anger on them and brought the full force of battle. Fire closed in around them, but they didn't understand. It burned them, but they didn't take it to heart.”
